metadata.description: BDD workflow toolkit: feature authoring with adversarial edge-case review, KB-backed Gherkin guidance, Playwright spec generation, and multi-persona spec review.

plugins.name: bdd-flow
plugins.description: BDD feature authoring with adversarial edge-case review and Playwright spec generation. Stack-neutral. Optionally consults the bdd-knowledge-base plugin when installed.

plugins.name: bdd-knowledge-base
plugins.description: Standalone BDD/Gherkin knowledge-base access: fetch, pin, verify, and query the published reference. No workflow dependency.

plugins.name: spec-personas
plugins.description: Multi-persona spec review with MoA synthesis and interactive refinement. Works on any spec, not just BDD.

plugins.name: bdd-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold a BDD-ready project: .bdd.json, feature/step templates, Playwright + CI wiring. Stack-opinionated.
